about: The capture vaults (work/27): normal sgit vaults (not pack vaults) on dev.send.sgraph.ai. A new vault opens before one reaches 20,000 files (admin/tools/capture.mjs rotates at 15,000). Vault ids only: the keys stay outside git (~/.sg-send/captures/<dir>/.sg_vault/local/, 0600), and a copy is sealed to the lead's key.
